top_signals.title: China Burns Less Oil and Coal as the Iran War Reshapes Its Energy Mix
top_signals.summary: The war in Iran is causing an enduring upset in global oil and gas markets with long-ranging consequences for the economy, the energy sector, and the climate. For many countries, this has resulted in skyrocketing energy prices and a rapid shift toward renewable energies in order to fill the import gap.
